subject.title: fix(discord): pass session file to plugin slash commands

question: Should this Discord command path use the transcript resolver before merge, or may it directly touch transition-only session-store helpers?
rationale: The code fix is mechanically clear, but any exception to the session-storage migration boundary is an owner-level compatibility choice.

options.title: Use the transcript resolver

options.title: Accept a temporary storage exception
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the direct session-store coupling, but should document why this command path is exempt during migration.

options.title: Pause until proof and revision arrive
options.body: Keep the draft blocked until the contributor adds live Discord proof and updates the implementation layer.
